name: Acid Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Acid damage.

name: Aid (Condition)
effects: Hit point maximum increased by 5 Hit Points.
Hit point maximum increases by a further 5 Hit Points for every Spell Slot Level above 2 used.
notes: The Aid condition remains even if the caster is removed from the party.

name: Arcane Acuity (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has a +1 bonus to its spell Attack Rolls and spell save DC for each remaining turn.
Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity takes damage.
Arcane Acuity has a maximum Duration: 10 turns.
notes: The duration is reduced by 1 at the beginning of each turn.

name: Arcane Charge (Condition)
effects: While damaging Threatened entities, deal +2 bonus damage with spells.[See: Bugs]
notes: If a single attack does multiple independent instances of damage, Arcane Charge boosts each one, so spells like Magic Missile benefit the most.
Some damage riders behave as independent sources of damage and get boosted by Arcane Charge. See DRS effects for a comprehensive list of damage riders that work like this.

name: Arcane Synergy (Condition)
effects: Weapon attacks deal additional damage equal to affected entity's Spell Casting Ability Modifier.
notes: Only applies on weapon attack rolls – e.g., Flame Blade is treated as a spell attack roll, and so does not apply.

This applies in addition to the standard damage modifier, so the spellcasting ability can increase damage multiple times if Infernal Rapier, Sylvan Scimitar, Shillelagh, Pact of the Blade, or similar effects are in use.

name: Armour of Agathys (Condition)
effects: Gained 5 × spell level temporary hit points. If hit with a melee attack, the attacker takes 5 × spell level Cold damage. This effect ends when the temporary hit points are lost.

name: Arms of Hadar (Condition)
effects: Can't take Reactions.

name: Aura of Conquest (Condition)
effects: Frightened enemies within 3 m (10 ft) take 5 Psychic damage per turn.

name: Aura of Courage (Condition)
effects: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be Frightened.
Can't be Frightened within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.

name: Aura of Devotion (Condition)
effects: The paladin and any nearby allies can't be Charmed.
Can't be Charmed within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.

name: Aura of Hate (Condition)
effects: This creature and all fiends and undead within 3 m (10 ft) gain this creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their melee weapon damage.
Gains a bonus to melee weapon damage equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.
notes: The effect does not apply to unarmed attacks such as with claws.
The effect really applies to all nearby fiends and undead, including enemies.

name: Aura of Protection (Condition)
effects: The creature and its allies within 3 m (10 ft) gain the creature's charisma modifier as a bonus to their saving throws.
Gains a bonus to saving throws equal to the charisma modifier of the creature emanating the aura.

name: Aura of Terror (Condition)
effects: Nearby enemies have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Saving Throws. Creatures that can't be Frightened are immune to this aura.
Bane's oppressive aura gives the affected entity Disadvantage on attack rolls and Saving Throws while within 3 m (10 ft) of the spellcaster.

name: Bane (Condition)
effects: Has a -1d4 penalty to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.

name: Banished (Condition)
effects: Banished from this plane of existence.
Can't be targeted.
Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions

name: Bardic Inspiration (Condition)
effects: Can use their Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d6 bonus to the next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw. Bonus depends on originating Bard's level

name: Barkskin (Condition)
effects: Armour Class increased to 16.
notes: If your Armour Class is lower than 16, Barkskin changes your base Armour Class to 16 with no other bonuses allowed from any source.

Mage Armour, Draconic Resilience, Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian), Unarmoured Defence (Monk) and Barkskin all change your base armour class and therefore do not stack. If you have multiple of these you will only get the benefit of the one that gives the most Armour Class.
Barkskin can work while in Wild Shape. This effect only works on forms with an Armour Class of less than 16.

name: Beacon of Hope (Condition)
effects: Has Advantage on Wisdom and Death Saving Throws.
Regains the maximum possible Hit Points when healed.

name: Beguiled (Condition)
effects: This creature has been charmed by Raphael and cannot target him with attacks or spells.

name: Black Tentacles (Condition)
effects: Restrained by dark tendrils. Affected entity can't move and takes 3d6 Bludgeoning damage per turn.
Attack Rolls against the affected entity have Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have Disadvantage

name: Blade Ward (Condition)
effects: Has Resistance against Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

name: Bleeding (Condition)
effects: Takes 2 SlashingDRS damage at the start of each turn and has Disadvantage on Constitution Saving Throws.
Removed by healing.
notes: Constructs, Elementals, Plants, Oozes, and Undead creatures except Ghasts and Ghouls are immune to Bleeding.[verify]

name: Bless (Condition)
effects: Gains a +1d4 bonus to Attack Rolls and Saving Throws.
notes: There are two functionally identical conditions that can stack with Bless: Elixir of Heroism and Singing Sword: Song from Phalar Aluve.

name: Blinded (Condition)
effects: Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage.

The affected creature has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls. Ranged attacks and spells of the affected creature have a range of 3 m (10 ft). Attack Rolls against affected creatures have Advantage. At the end of each turn, the affected creature makes a Constitution Saving Throw. If successful, the condition is removed.
sources: Flurry of Moths: Mighty Blinding Swarm
notes: Blinded creatures cannot make Opportunity Attacks
Being Blinded has no effect on the range of Throw or any other action with the IgnoreVisionBlock flag.

name: Blindness (Condition)
effects: Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage.
At the end of each turn, the affected creature rolls a Constitution Saving Throw against the Spell Save DC of the caster. If successful, the condition is removed.

name: Bloodlust (Condition)
effects: Creature can attack three times. It regains 3d8 Hit Points if it lands a killing blow.

name: Bone Chilled (Condition)
effects: Can not regain hit points.
Cannot help Downed characters.
If Undead, has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls.

name: Branding Smite (Condition)
effects: Cannot turn Invisible.

name: Bull's Strength (Condition)
effects: Has Advantage on Strength Checks. Weight Limit doubled.
Has Advantage on Strength Checks. Weight Limit doubled.
notes: Functionally equivalent to Aspect of the Beast: Bear, and does not stack.

name: Burning (Condition)
effects: Takes 1d4 Fire damage per turn. Can be removed with the Help action, using a Healing Potion or gaining Wet. Immune from if Wet. Dip action can be used on Burning characters or objects.
notes: Conditions that share the same StackID prevent the additional application of these conditions until the original condition has timed out. As a result, a character that is affected by Burning will not also be affected by Melting, meaning this character may walk around freely in lava while only receiving 1d4 Fire damage instead of 10d6 Fire damage.
Burning creatures take double damage from the Fire Elemental's Multiattack, and are made Brittle by the Water Elemental's Winter's Breath.
Burning creatures take an additional 1d4 Weapon damage when attacked by Dragon's Grasp or Firestoker.

name: Cat's Grace (Condition)
effects: Has Advantage on Dexterity Checks. Only takes half damage from falling.
Has Advantage on Dexterity Checks. Only takes half damage from falling.

name: Charmed (Condition)
effects: Cannot attack the spellcaster. The spellcaster has Advantage on Charisma Checks in dialogue.

name: Chilled (Condition)
effects: Affected entity is vulnerable to Cold damage and resistant to Fire damage.
Applying Wet to a chilled entity will make it Frozen for Duration: 1 turn.
notes: The order of application of conditions matters. Chilling an already wet target will not freeze it. It must be chilled and then wet. However, applying wet to an already wet and chilled target will freeze it.

The duration of the Frozen condition ticks down at the start of the affected creature's turn. With a duration of just 1 turn, this means the effect will immediately end at the start of the frozen creature's turn without disabling it for even a single turn. When applied with Encrusted with Frost, Frozen will instead last 2 turns (so effectively 1 full round), so it does not have this issue.

name: Cloud of Daggers (Condition)
effects: Takes 4d4 Slashing per turn. This damage is increased by 2d4 Slashing for for each spell slot level above 2nd used to cast Cloud of Daggers.

name: Cold Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Cold damage.

name: Colour Spray (Condition)
effects: Has Disadvantage on Attack Rolls. Range of attacks and spells reduced to 3 m (10 ft).
Attack Rolls against Blinded creatures have Advantage.

name: Confused (Condition)
effects: Affected entity is hostile to everyone, wanders around aimlessly, and occasionally skips turns in its stupor
notes: An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways.

name: Crown of Madness (Condition)
effects: Instilled with magical madness. Will attack the nearest creature, other than the spellcaster.
notes: An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways.

name: Crusader's Mantle (Condition)
effects: Near a paladin's holy aura. Weapon attacks deal an additional 1d4 Radiant damage.

name: Darkvision (Condition)
effects: Can see in the dark out to the range of 12 m (40 ft).
Can see in the dark out to the range of 24 m (80 ft).

name: Dazed (Condition)
effects: Has Disadvantage on Wisdom Saving Throws, can't take Reactions, and loses the Dexterity bonus to their Armour Class.
Removed if an ally Helps this creature.

name: Dead (Condition)
effects: This creature is dead.
notes: This condition can be removed from hirelings, the player character, and their companions with Revivify, a Scroll of Revivify, the Scroll of True Resurrection or through Withers' services. Non-playable characters cannot be revived after dying.
In most cases, companions who die before recruitment – or during certain plot events – cannot be revived.
Temporary companions with scripted deaths, namely Alfira and Losiir, cannot be revived.

name: Death Ward (Condition)
effects: The next time damage would reduce the affected entity to 0 Hit Points, it remains conscious with 1 Hit Point left.

name: Disguise Self (Condition)
effects: Appearance is entirely changed.
notes: Disguised companions and hirelings revert to their normal form upon leaving the active party.

name: Dominated (Condition)
effects: Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom Saving Throw.
Affected entity will follow and fight alongside the caster of this spell. Every time it takes damage, it may break the caster's control over it with a successful Wisdom Saving Throw.
notes: An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways.

name: Downed (Condition)
effects: If you reach 0 hit points, you fall Unconscious and must make Death Saving Throws. On 3 successes, you stop bleeding out and become Stable. On 3 failures, you die. Any damage you receive while unconscious counts as one failure. If you regain any Hit Points, the condition is removed. If an ally helps you, you regain 1 hit point.

name: Drunk (Condition)
effects: Has Disadvantage on Dexterity and Charisma Checks.
notes: Cheeky Tipple grants immunity to the negative effects of this condition.

name: Dying (Condition)
effects: This creature is dying. It will not move, take actions, or respond to damage in any way.
Attacks at melee range are guaranteed to hit and be critical hits. Ranged attacks have Advantage.
notes: This condition has no in-game description.
Seems to prevent healing.[verify]

name: Encrusted with Frost (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.

When there are 7 or more turns remaining, the entity must succeed a DC 12 Constitution Saving Throw or take 1d4 ColdDRS and become Frozen. On a successful save, it only takes half damage. Afterward, the frost sloughs away.
Removed by Burning.
notes: Markoheshkir's Encrusted with Frost condition comes from the Frost of Dark Winter variant of Kereska's Favour.
Testing as of Patch 7 confirms that the save is fixed DC 12, despite the combat log showing a variable DC calculation involving Proficiency and Spellcasting Ability Modifier bonuses.

name: Ensnared (Condition)
effects: Affected entity can't move. Attack Rolls against it have Advantage, while its Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have Disadvantage.
notes: Ensnared creatures cannot make an attack of opportunity despite the game warning of it with the red arrow.

name: Entangled (Condition)
effects: Cannot move. Attack Rolls against the creature have Advantage, while the creature's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have Disadvantage.

name: Exhausted (Condition)
effects: Lack of rest has left you exhausted. There are six levels of exhaustion, and each level is worse than the last. Completing a Long Rest reduces your exhaustion level by 1.

name: Expeditious Retreat (Condition)
effects: Dash available as a Bonus Action.

name: Faerie Fire (Condition)
effects: Shedding dim light. Incoming attacks have Advantage. Cannot be Invisible.

name: False Life (Condition)
effects: Gain 7 temporary hit points plus 5 additional for each spell slot level above the first.

name: Feather Fall (Condition)
effects: Rate of falling is slowed, granting Immunity to Falling damage.
notes: This effect also prevents being knocked Prone when falling from heights of greater than 8 m (27 ft).

name: Feeble (Condition)
effects: Deal only half damage with weapon attacks that use Strength. At the end of each turn, the affected creature can make a Constitution Saving Throw to end this condition.

name: Fire Resistance (Condition)
effects: You gain Resistance to Fire damage, and can no longer Burn.

name: Force Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Force damage.

name: Freedom of Movement (Condition)
effects: The affected creature's Movement Speed cannot be reduced by Difficult Terrain, spells or magical effects. The affected creature cannot be Paralyzed or Restrained.

name: Frightened (Condition)
effects: Cannot move. Frightened entities also have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
Cannot move. Frightened entities also have Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.
notes: Mortal Reminder applies a variant of this condition, which loses duration on the Frightened creature's turn rather than the source of the effect's turn.

name: Frozen (Condition)
effects: Affected entity is utterly enamelled in ice and is Incapacitated. If it is dealt Bludgeoning, Thunder, or Force damage, the ice shatters, ending the condition.
Gains Vulnerability to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage.
Gains Resistance to Fire damage.
Gains immunity to Burning and Encrusted with Frost.
notes: Can be inflicted by making the target Chilled then Wet, replacing both conditions. Applying the conditions in the other order does not work.
The vulnerabilities are not mentioned on the in-game tooltip.

name: Greater Invisibility (Condition)
effects: Entity has Advantage on Attack Rolls. Attack Rolls against it have Disadvantage When interacting with items, casting spells, or attacking, the entity needs to succeed on a Stealth Check to maintain Invisibility. The Check becomes harder with each successful attempt.

name: Guidance (Condition)
effects: Gains a +1d4 bonus to Ability Checks.

name: Guiding Bolt (Condition)
effects: The next Attack Roll made against this creature has Advantage.

name: Hastened (Condition)
effects: Creature has a +2 bonus to Armour Class, Advantage on Dexterity Saving Throws, its Movement Speed increases by 9 m (30 ft),[See: Bugs] and it can take one additional Action per turn. When the condition ends, the creature becomes Lethargic.
notes: Terazul grants a similar condition, The Terazul Jitters, which stacks with this condition.

In honour mode only, Slowed and similar conditions end Hastened. This is because for honour mode specifically, these conditions are assigned the HASTE stack ID and a higher stack priority than Hastened. Mind Sanctuary: Haste also ends Hastened in honour mode, potentially causing creatures to accidentally become Lethargic.

name: Heat Metal (Condition)
effects: Heats up a metal weapon or armour on a creature with no save (weapon is automatically prioritized).
Metal weapons are dropped if the creature holding it fails their initial Saving Throw.
If the creature is touching the heated metal item, they receive Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.

Each subsequent turn, if the creature is still touching the metal, the spellcaster can use Reapply Heat Metal to deal another 2d8 Fire damage, forcing the creature to pass a Saving Throw again or drop the item (if it is a metal weapon).

name: Heroism (Condition)
effects: Can't be Frightened. Receive 5 temporary hit points per turn.

name: Hiding (Condition)
effects: Affected entity is invisible to enemies until it crosses their cone of sight.
The entity has Advantage on all Attack Rolls.

name: Hold Monster (Condition)
effects: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Attacks against the entity have Advantage.
Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within 3 m (10 ft).
Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

name: Hold Person (Condition)
effects: Affected entity can't Move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Attacks against the entity automatically succeed their Attack Roll.
Attacks against the entity are always Critical Hits if the attacker is within Range: 3 m (10 ft).
Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
At the end of each turn, the affected entity makes a Wisdom Saving Throw. On a successful save, the condition is removed.

name: Improved Bardic Inspiration (Condition)
effects: Can use their Bardic Inspiration to add a +1d12 bonus to the next Attack Roll, Ability Check, or Saving Throw.

name: Incapacitated (Condition)
effects: Cannot take Actions or Reactions.
Lose Concentration, if maintaining a Concentration spell.
notes: The affected entity cannot perform any actions, including Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Incapacitated entities cannot move.

name: Jump (Condition)
effects: Jump distance is tripled.

name: Knocked Out (Condition)
effects: The affected entity which was Temporarily Hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions. The affected entity regains consciousness after a Long Rest.
The affected entity which was permanently hostile before cannot move or take actions, bonus actions or reactions.

name: Lethargic (Condition)
effects: Consumed by exhaustion in the aftermath of Haste.
Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
notes: Becoming Lethargic does not break Concentration.

name: Lightly Obscured (Condition)
effects: Hiding in a Lightly Obscured area. Has to make a Stealth check when caught.

name: Lightning Charges (Condition)
effects: Lightning courses through you. You have +1 to Attack Rolls and deal an additional 1 Lightning damage.
If you gain 5 charges, they are consumed the next time you deal damage, and you deal an additional 1d8 LightningDRS damage.
You lose 1 charge per turn.
notes: The extra damage is added to Falling damage if the falling creature was shoved or pushed by someone with Lightning Charges.
Enemies with lightning resistance do not receive the additional 1 Lightning damage.
Patch #3 changed how Lightning Charge damages enemies: For Area of Effect spells such as Shatter, the Lightning Charge damage is now dealt to every target hit.
For spells with two damage components such as Ice Knife or Ice Storm, Lightning Charge damage is added to every component that damages a target.
Draconic Bloodline Sorcerers with a Lightning Ancestor can no longer increase the Lightning charge damage through Elemental Affinity.

name: Lightning Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Lightning damage. Can no longer be Shocked, Electrocuted, Jolted, or otherwise affected by lightning.

name: Longstrider (Condition)
effects: Increase a creature's Movement Speed by 3 m (10 ft).

name: Madness (Condition)
effects: Hostile to everyone in the vicinity.
notes: An affected party member is fully controlled by the game's AI, which may behave in unexpected ways.

name: Mage Armour (Condition)
effects: Base Armour Class is 13.
notes: The normal base Armour Class is 10 + Dexterity modifier, while this changes it to 13 + Dexterity modifier. You will still get bonuses from other sources that don't change your base armour class like +1 AC robes, Bracers of Defence, Shield of Faith, etc.
Gloves and Helmets marked as Light, Medium or Heavy Armour count as armour, and will prevent Mage Armour from working.
Mage Armour works while wearing a Shield.

Mage Armour, Draconic Resilience, Unarmoured Defence (Barbarian), Unarmoured Defence (Monk) and Barkskin all change your base armour class and therefore does not stack. If you have multiple of these you will only get the benefit of the one that gives the most Armour Class.
Mage Armour can work while in Wild Shape as long as you have no armour equipped in any slot before transforming. This effect only works on forms with a base Armour Class of less than 13.
Mage Armour does not count as wearing armour for things like Unarmoured Movement, Become the Bulwark and Defence.

name: Maimed (Condition)
effects: The affected creature's Movement Speed is reduced to 0.
The affected creature has Disadvantage on Dexterity Saving Throws.
The condition is removed by healing.
notes: This condition is known as CRIPPLED in the game files, but the display name is Maimed. It may have been renamed during development, as its localization string indicates "Maimed" is version 2 of that string.
Ring of Free Action grants immunity to maimed.

name: Martial Exertion (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has pushed past its physical limits, taking 6d6 Piercing damage per turn to perform an additional attack per turn and to double its movement speed.

name: Mirror Image (Condition)
effects: The mirror image distracts attackers, increasing the spellcaster's Armour Class by 3 per duplicate image. When the caster successfully evades an attack, one of the images disappears.

name: Momentum (Condition)
effects: Spurred on by a sense of urgency. Movement Speed increased by 1.5 m (5 ft) per remaining duration of this effect.
Removed when Restrained, Incapacitated, Prone, or slowed down.
Momentum has a maximum Duration: 5 turns.
notes: The Early Access item Chain of Liberation interacted with Momentum: once per turn, the wearer could reduce the duration of their Momentum by 1 turn to Sprint, rushing forward in a straight 6m / 20ft. line that did not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

name: Moonbeam (Condition)
effects: Creature is engulfed by ghostly flames that inflict 2~20 Radiant damage per turn. On a successful save, the creature still takes half damage.

name: Necrotic Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Necrotic damage.
notes: For sources of necrotic resistance that are unrelated to the condition, refer to this list.

name: Paralysed (Condition)
effects: Affected entity can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
Attacks against the entity are always critical hits if the attacker is within 3 m (10 ft).
Attack rolls against the entity have Advantage.
Affected entity automatically fails all Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.

name: Pass Without Trace (Condition)
effects: Veiled by an ally. +10 bonus to Stealth Checks.

name: Petrified (Condition)
effects: Turned to stone. Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions.
notes: Petrified creatures additionally: Are resistant to all damage types
Are immune to all Poisoned conditions
Have all attacks against them made with Advantage
Automatically fail Strength and Dexterity saving throws
Cannot detect crimes such as theft and murder[verify]
Cannot be pickpocketed
Cannot be Downed, and instead disintegrate upon reaching 0 HP
Are immune to Weapon Dropped!
Cannot speak or participate in dialogue
Lose concentration
Petrified can be cured by: Basilisk Oil
Greater Restoration

name: Phantasmal Killer (Condition)
effects: Affected entity is haunted by its worst nightmares.
It takes 4d10 Psychic damage per turn, cannot move, and has Disadvantage on Ability Checks and Attack Rolls.

name: Pinned (Condition)
effects: Pinned under a beam.

name: Plant Growth (Condition)
effects: The ground is covered with plants and weeds. Movement Speed is quartered.

name: Poison Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Poison damage. Can no longer be Poisoned.

name: Poisoned (Condition)
effects: Suffers Disadvantage on Attack Rolls and Ability Checks.
notes: A Cup of Oil can be drunk to inflict the almost identical condition of Oily Sup.
All rotten consumables will inflict this condition when consumed, making them a reliable source of triggering Aspect of the Beast: Honey Badger's passive ability.

name: Polymorphed (Condition)
effects: You are now a particularly ripe wheel of cheese, unpleasant to the nostril.
Creature is turned into a harmless sheep with 3 Hit Points for 5 turns. If the sheep's Hit Points are reduced to 0, the creature reverts to its original form with its original Hit Points.
Changed into a beast.

name: Produce Flame (Condition)
effects: A flickering flame sheds light in a 9 m (30 ft) radius around the creature.

name: Prone (Condition)
effects: Can't move or take Actions, Bonus Actions, or Reactions, and has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
Attacks against a Prone creature have Advantage if they're made within 3 m (10 ft) of the creature.
A Prone creature must spend half its Movement Speed to stand up.
Falling Prone immediately ends Concentration.
If a creatures falls Prone on its turn, the turn immediately ends.
notes: A character with the Athlete feat spends only 1.5 m (5 ft) of Movement Speed to stand up.

If a character falls Prone, ending their turn, another character acting on the same turn in initiative can use the Help action to remove the Prone condition, effectively "un-skipping" that character's turn and allowing them to act normally. Concentration is still broken, however.

Creatures use 50% of their available movement speed to stand up. So, knocking a creature Prone and reducing its movement speed below 50% does not prevent it from standing up and automatically skip its next turn.

name: Protection from Evil and Good (Condition)
effects: The target is protected against Aberrations, Celestials, Elementals, Fey, Fiends, and Undead. These creatures have Disadvantage on Attack Rolls against the target.
Can't be Frightened, or Possessed.
sources: Scroll of Protection from Evil and Good

name: Protection from Poison (Condition)
effects: All previous Poisonous effects afflicting the target are neutralized
Target gains Advantage on Saving Throws against being Poisoned
Target gains Resistance to Poison damage

name: Psionic Weakening (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has Disadvantage on Constitution, Wisdom and Intelligence Saving Throws. Replaces effects from other elixirs when drunk.

name: Psychic Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Psychic damage.

name: Radiant Resistance (Condition)
effects: Resistant to Radiant damage.

name: Radiating Orb (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has -1 to Attack Rolls per remaining turn. It also sheds bright light in an area surrounding it. Reduce the duration by 2 each time the entity makes an attack.
notes: The bright light from this condition does not count as Daylight.
Duration of the condition is limited to a maximum of Duration: 10 turns; a maximum effect of -10 to Attack Rolls from this condition.

name: Ray of Frost (Condition)
effects: Movement Speed is reduced by 3 m (10 ft).

name: Reeling (Condition)
effects: Recovering from receiving a terrible blow or hitting a strong metal. Has a -1 penalty to Attack Rolls for every turn remaining.
Reeling has a maximum Duration: 10 turns.
notes: All remaining stacks of Reeling are removed on the next attack made by the Reeling creature, whether or not it hits. Consequently, Giantbreaker is the only item capable of adding additional stacks; to receive Reeling from any of the adamantine items, a creature has to attack, clearing any previous stacks before gaining new ones. MAG_ATTACK_DEBUFF contains "RemoveConditions" "IsAttack()" and "RemoveEvents" "OnAttack". The target of the attack makes no difference.
If a creature has a Multiattack action, the attack penalty applies to all attacks in the Multiattack before the duration changes.

name: Resistance (Condition)
effects: Gains a +1d4 bonus to Saving Throws.

name: Restrained (Condition)
effects: Cannot move. Attack Rolls against the affected entity have Advantage, while the entity's Attack Rolls and Dexterity Saving Throws have Disadvantage

name: Reverberation (Condition)
effects: Affected entity has a -1 penalty to Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution Saving Throws per remaining turn.
When the entity has 5 or more turns of Reverberation, it takes 1d4 ThunderDRS damage and must succeed a DC 10 Constitution Saving Throw or fall Prone. The condition is removed afterward.
Creatures Immune to Thunder damage can't receive Reverberation.
notes: Since the penalty to Constitution saving throws is also applied to the saving throw against being knocked Prone after stacking 5 turns of Reverberation, the DC for this saving throw is effectively 15.

name: Searing Smite (Condition)
effects: Takes 1d6 Fire damage per turn.
The condition ends if target succeeds a Constitution Saving Throw.

name: See Invisibility (Condition)
effects: Can see Invisible creatures within 9 m (30 ft). Creatures must succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw or lose their Invisibility.

name: Shield (Condition)
effects: Immune to Magic Missile. Armour Class is increased by 5.

name: Shield of Faith (Condition)
effects: Receives +2 bonus to Armour Class.

name: Shillelagh (Condition)
effects: Creature's weapon is magical and deals 4d8 Bludgeoning damage. Attack Rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting Ability Modifier. This condition is only available to the summoned Dryad
Creature's weapon is magical and deals 1d8 Bludgeoning damage. Attack Rolls use the wielder's Spellcasting modifier.
notes: Can only affect quarterstaves or clubs, per the same name spell.
Though not mentioned in the in-game description of the condition specifically, the damage dealt also adds the wielder's spellcasting ability modifier.

name: Shocking Grasp (Condition)
effects: Cannot take Reactions.
notes: Shocking Grasp prevents the spending of Reaction points. Reactions which do not require Reaction points are still usable by affected creatures.

name: Shrouded (Condition)

name: Threatened (Condition)
effects: An enemy is close. Has Disadvantage on ranged Attack Rolls.
notes: A creature's melee range can be affected by the reach of their melee weapon.

The condition itself has no effect on attacks against the threatening enemy; the disadvantage only applies to ranged attacks against other creatures. If multiple enemies are in threatening range, then the Threatened creature will have disadvantage against all of them.

However, there is also a separate source of disadvantage ("Target is too close") when making a ranged attack from within 3 m (10 ft) of a target, meaning most creatures will have disadvantage on ranged attacks against a threatening creature. This can be removed by Crossbow Expert: Point-Blank, making it possible to use crossbow attacks without disadvantage against an enemy at close range. This does not work, however, if one is Threatened by multiple creatures.

Because of how the "Target is too close" effect is implemented, it is possible for a target to be within an aura with a range of 3 m (10 ft) (such as Aura of Murder) while not being close enough to grant disadvantage on ranged attacks. This is because the effect measures the distance from the centre of the attacker to the target, while an aura accounts for the size of a creature's hitbox.
